description.value: You grant the subject’s awareness to extend a fraction of a second into the future, allowing them to better perform a particular combat maneuver. Select one type of combat maneuver, such as bull rush or reposition, when you cast this spell. The subject gains a +2 enhancement bonus to combat maneuver checks of that type for the duration of the effect.
